limitations: This proposed grounding repair uses only supplied source and establishes no semantic equivalence, completeness, acceptance, authority, qualification or execution.

patches.reason: Corrects the section-ID transcription error. Lines 384–388 directly support human or conditionally admitted proxy occupancy and the stated exclusions.

replacement.quote:
The frame may be occupied by direct human authority or by a bounded proxy
admitted under the proxy grant of EVALUATION §5, ACTIVATION §1 (Roles and
delegation), identity law and current project authority. It is not a
universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime executive
observer (P6, RF-016).
